headline.en: UNI still net inflationary at +1.64%/yr; price drifting toward the $5.96 DAO anchor with real-yield catalyst absent from the forum.
headline.zh: UNI 年化净增发仍达 +1.64%,币价向 $5.96 的 DAO 内在锚缓慢回落,real-yield 催化剂在治理论坛上明显缺席。

keyChanges.en: Annualized buyback ($34.42M) burns only 5.43M UNI vs 20M emission — burn narrative mathematically fails to offset supply at $6.34.
keyChanges.zh: 年化 buyback 预算 $34.42M 仅能销毁 5.43M UNI,不敌 20M 的年度增发,在 $6.34 价位上销毁叙事在数学上无法对冲供给。

keyChanges.en: Price -6.5% on 7d with only $11.45M daily volume on a $3.95B cap (0.29% turnover) — distribution without buyer conviction.
keyChanges.zh: 7 日跌 6.5%,而 24h 成交仅 $11.45M / 市值 $3.95B(换手率 0.29%),属于无买盘承接的派发结构。

keyChanges.en: Binance L/S account ratio 1.79 with funding near-zero (+0.01%) — retail is long-heavy but unpaid, classic setup for a squeeze lower.
keyChanges.zh: Binance 多空账户比 1.79,资金费率贴近 0(+0.01%),散户单边做多却无溢价,是向下挤仓的典型结构。

contrarianObservation.en: Two live Temp Checks — 'Activate v4 Protocol Fees' and 'Robinhood Chain Protocol Fee Expansion' — could expand the buyback denominator materially. If both pass, net-inflation math flips before real-yield even needs to ship, and the treasury still holds 267M UNI in optionality.
contrarianObservation.zh: 论坛上两个 Temp Check——'Activate v4 Protocol Fees' 与 'Robinhood Chain 协议费扩张'——若通过,将实质性放大 buyback 的分子。届时不需要 real-yield 落地,净通胀方程即可翻转,且 Timelock 仍握有 267M UNI 的期权价值。

watchNext.zh: v4 协议费与 Robinhood Chain 两项 Temp Check 的投票走向——直接决定 buyback 分子的量级。

watchNext.en: Whether a real-yield RFC re-enters the top 5 forum threads; its current absence is a stalling signal.
watchNext.zh: real-yield 相关 RFC 是否重新进入论坛热帖前五;目前的缺席本身就是停滞信号。

watchNext.en: Defense of the $5.96 treasury-burn anchor on any risk-off leg; a clean break puts $4-5 in play fast.
watchNext.zh: 在风险 off 行情中 $5.96 财库销毁锚位能否守住;一旦有效跌破,$4-5 区间将迅速被打开。

fullReasoning.en: The core problem is unchanged and now quantified: at $6.34, buyback-burn destroys 5.43M UNI/yr against 20M in emissions, leaving UNI +1.64% net inflationary. The 'fee switch' narrative is doing zero work at this price — you would need either revenue to roughly quadruple, or price to run well above $20, to flip the equation. Neither is imminent. Governance confirms the stall: the top forum threads are Sentinel rotations, ERC-6551 experiments, privacy hooks, and two Temp Checks on fee expansion. Notably, no real-yield RFC in the top 5 — the single most important catalyst in the framework is not on the front burner. Tape confirms the fundamentals: -6.5% on the week, $11.45M daily volume on a $3.95B cap is capitulation-thin, and a 1.79 long/short ratio with flat funding tells you retail is trapped rather than paying up. Price sits $0.38 above the $5.96 DAO-implied mark; that is a valuation ceiling, not support. Base case is a retest of $5.96 and probing of $4-5 institutional zone within 1-4 weeks. The saving grace is optionality: if v4 protocol fees activate, the denominator on burn expands non-linearly, and the treasury still holds 267M UNI to fund a pivot. That is the trade to be early on, not the trade to be in today.
fullReasoning.zh: 核心矛盾未变且已被量化:在 $6.34 价位,buyback 年销毁 5.43M UNI,而年度增发 20M,UNI 净增发仍达 +1.64%。'费率开关'叙事在此价格下毫无实际作用——要翻转方程,要么协议收入约翻四倍,要么币价冲上 $20 以上,两者短期都不现实。治理端印证了停滞:论坛前五帖是 Sentinel 地址轮换、ERC-6551 实验、隐私 hook,以及两个关于费用扩张的 Temp Check。值得注意的是,前五中没有任何 real-yield 相关 RFC——本框架下最关键的催化剂并未被推到台前。盘面进一步验证基本面:7 日 -6.5%,$11.45M 日成交对应 $3.95B 市值(换手率仅 0.29%),属于承接稀薄的派发行情;多空比 1.79 叠加近零资金费率,说明散户被套但无人愿意付溢价加多,是标准的向下挤仓结构。当前价距 $5.96 DAO 隐含成本仅 $0.38,该位是估值天花板而非支撑。基准情景为 1-4 周内回测 $5.96,并试探 $4-5 的机构建仓区间。唯一的救赎在于 optionality:v4 协议费若真正激活,将非线性扩大 buyback 分母,加之 Timelock 仍持有 267M UNI 作为战略弹药——这是值得提前布局的机会,但不是今天该持有的仓位。
